scope: minimum decisions required to remove current full-release semantic blockers

revisions.HR-001: Attach each 2014/2018 slot's actual prompt, answer-index entry, and one-to-one mapping; the existence of an auditable mapping is not a batch approval.
revisions.HR-002: List the specific 2015 Q3 building, architect, year, style, and answer-index entry so that uniqueness can be checked.
revisions.PL-001: Replace different-facility-as-false logic: each distractor needs evidence that its feature does not apply to the target facility; facilities may share features.
revisions.BC-002: List every a–t slot with answer type and answer-index evidence; no blanket approval from contextual summary.
revisions.EN-DEF-002: Revise definition to: average time elapsed from air entering the room until it reaches a specified indoor point; do not describe a deterministic single air parcel arrival time.
revisions.EN-DEF-003: Keep the stack-ventilation zero-pressure-difference definition, but remove 等圧帯 as a false distractor until its synonym relationship is independently resolved.
revisions.EN-CS-002: Keep the short-circuit/effectiveness core proposition, but replace the unconditional ACH-doubling concentration distractor; it can hold under steady-state, constant-generation conditions.
revisions.EN-CS-003: Keep the surface-temperature/dew-point core proposition, but replace the unconditional RH-100%-always-condenses distractor; surface state and temperature conditions matter.
